description: American Business explains how businesses work in a free-enterprise economy: their history, finances, ethics and regulation, and how the five main areas of a business fit together — with a look at business careers.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Sub-items within requirements 1–3 are summarized.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: How business works
requirements.summary: Free enterprise, business history and leaders, the main areas of a business, labor unions and how business affects the economy.

requirements.title: Business finance
requirements.summary: Financial statements, how interest rates, taxes and government spending affect business, raising capital and insurance.

requirements.title: Business decisions
requirements.summary: Profit, sustainable practices, ethics in decisions, and physical versus online businesses.

requirements.title: Workplace laws
requirements.summary: The Department of Labor and major federal laws that protect workers.

requirements.title: Researching a business
requirements.summary: Researching one business across its main areas of operation.

requirements.title: Business careers
requirements.summary: One option: exploring careers in an area of business, or interviewing a business leader.
